Similarly the operating businesses moved with their people via a one-year compensation/benefits-continuity covenant and service-credit recognition, so processes and organization/people transferred coherently alongside each other, giving gap_56=0; ILG's directors/officers ceased serving but the continuing workforce was contractually retained, coded T6=partial. Because no gap was coded, gap_mitigated=NA (the absence of a broader transition-services agreement is noted but no structural gap was documented at closing).
